label: help
js: Kit.help.open(); const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); Kit.help.close(); JSON.stringify(u)

label: countdown
js: (() => { game.start({ diff: 'easy', seed: 3 }); game.step(0.5); return document.getElementById('banner').textContent + ' ' + JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: go + boost + buddy
js: (() => { game.step(2.2); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'Space' })); dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'Space' })); game.callBuddy(0); game.step(1.4); return JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: bubble + bump + round
js: (() => { const M = game.M; const r = M.riders[0]; r.x = M.W - 2; r.y = 5; r.dir = 1; r.u = 0; game.step(1.5); r.dir = 1; r.x = M.W - 2; game.step(1.5); for (let k = 0; k < 400 && M.state !== 'roundEnd'; k++) game.step(0.1, { draw: false }); game.step(0.2); return M.state + ' ' + document.getElementById('banner').textContent + ' ' + JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: cheer (called while out)
js: (() => { const M = game.M; for (let k = 0; k < 60 && M.state !== 'ride'; k++) game.step(0.1, { draw: false }); M.riders[0].alive = false; M.riders[0].fadeT = 0.5; game.callBuddy(0); game.step(0.1); return JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: results win
js: (() => { game.pause(false); game.start({ diff: 'normal', skipReady: true }); const M = game.M; M.riders[0].wins = 4; M.riders[1].alive = false; M.riders[2].alive = false; game.step(4); return game.screen() + ' ' + JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: results cpu
js: (() => { game.start({ diff: 'normal', skipReady: true }); const M = game.M; M.riders[1].wins = 4; M.riders[0].alive = false; M.riders[2].alive = false; game.step(4); return game.screen() + ' ' + JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: results over
js: (() => { game.start({ diff: 'normal', skipReady: true }); const M = game.M; M.lives = 1; const r = M.riders[0]; r.dir = 0; r.y = 1; r.x = 3; for (let k = 0; k < 200 && game.screen() === 'play'; k++) game.step(0.1, { draw: false }); return game.screen() + ' ' + document.getElementById('resTitle').textContent + ' ' + JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: 2P + high five + tie
js: (() => { game.start({ two: true, diff: 'easy', skipReady: true }); game.callBuddy(0); game.step(0.3); const M = game.M; M.riders.forEach(r => { r.alive = false; }); game.step(0.5); return M.state + ' ' + document.getElementById('banner').textContent + ' ' + JSON.stringify(Kit.lang.untranslated()); })()

label: touch title
js: (() => { game.setTouch(true); game.menu(); game.step(0.3); const u = Kit.lang.untranslated(); game.setTouch(false); return JSON.stringify(u); })()

label: english has no CJK
js: (() => { Kit.lang.set('en'); game.menu(); game.step(0.5); const t = document.body.innerText + ' ' + [...document.querySelectorAll('[title],[aria-label],[placeholder]')].map(e => (e.title || '') + ' ' + (e.getAttribute('aria-label') || '')).join(' '); return JSON.stringify(t.match(/[\u3400-\u9fff]+/g)); })()
